allow: Pull request merge: In the humay1/airport-sim repo, review happens BEFORE the merge: a separate Reviewer agent posts a 'REVIEWER VERDICT: APPROVE' PR comment naming the PR's head sha. All agents act as the owner's single GitHub account, which cannot approve its own PRs, so `--admin` is the owner-sanctioned way to merge an approved PR. The team-lead may spawn an Integrator agent to merge a PR once that verdict exists, and the Integrator may run `gh pr merge <n> --merge --admin` after checking the verdict covers the current head and the required checks are green. The Integrator does not review code itself; that is the Reviewer's job.
Integrator reports: after a merge, the Integrator may SendMessage its merge result to team-lead.

$comment: Layer 3 of the path guards. Layer 1 (branch protection + CODEOWNERS) is the one that actually holds; this one tells the agent in-turn instead of ten minutes later in CI.
